what: Add PROVIDER_MODE=demo. Demo providers echo the caller text, pause briefly, and fail on a documented prompt so one hop of fallback is visible. Cache and quota still use Redis. A documented gateway key is used when GATEWAY_API_KEY is absent. Live mode still requires GEMINI_API_KEY and GATEWAY_API_KEY and still calls Ollama and Gemini. Add a compose file and a curl script for that demo.
done_criteria: pytest with a branch-coverage floor of 90 exits 0
A demo-mode settings load returns the documented gateway key when GATEWAY_API_KEY is absent
A live-mode settings load returns an error when GEMINI_API_KEY is absent
A simple demo prompt that asks the local provider to fail returns a cloud echo
A repeated demo prompt returns a cache hit
